messages:
oliver_sales: Quick ask  Can we schedule a short 30m window Weds 09:30 PT to sweep the Atlas POC? Need owners for: 1) revoke hosted API keys, 2) drain+terminate pool dp-atlas, 3) remove VPC peering & cleanup SGs, 4) export + archive logs, 5) provide legal attestation for data disposal. Who can take each?

mira_ops: I can take dp-atlas and VPC steps. Plan: set the pool to drain, wait 5m for inflight, then terminate. Will mute alerts during process. Commands I use:
```bash
rctl pool drain dp-atlas --grace 300 --wait
rctl pool terminate dp-atlas --force
```

sec_anshu: I'll handle API key revocation and rotation. I'll run revoke after logs are exported so audit shows last usage. Revocation call example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/v1/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant":"atlas-poc","scope":"all"}'

ben_billing: Billing note: on-demand GPU hours stop at termination; no reserved commit so charges cease. I can produce a short prorated usage statement after termination.

legal_june: Per contract we have a 90-day retention default for certain customer data. If Atlas signs an immediate-disposal waiver, we can destroy earlier and provide attestation. I'll draft attestation language now.

oliver_sales: Owners: mira_ops = pool+vpc+logs export, sec_anshu = keys, ben_billing = billing, legal_june = attestation. Please react with :white_check_mark: if Weds 09:30 PT works.

mira_ops: :white_check_mark: I'll be on the call and will post S3 links and termination timestamp.

sec_anshu: :white_check_mark: Will schedule revoke at T+2 after S3 upload.

ben_billing: :white_check_mark: I'll prepare the usage note and send to customer after termination.

legal_june: :white_check_mark: Drafted attestation, will post for signature if customer opts in.

ops-bot: Runbook created POC-44777 and attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-asset-sweep (automated). Will post completion summary with artifacts.

oliver_sales: Thanks all. After completion please attach: S3 log export link, revocation audit, pool termination timestamp, and signed attestation or waiver.
